title: RDS Workshops Database
description: UCSB Library Research Data Services Workshop Catalogue

workshops.title: RDS Workshops
workshops.description: Workshop catalogue with offerings, instructors, and metadata

workshop_areas.title: Workshop ↔ Areas
workshop_areas.description: Many-to-many relationship: workshops to research areas

active_workshops.title: Active Workshops
active_workshops.sql: SELECT w.*, f.label as format FROM workshops w LEFT JOIN formats f ON w.format_id = f.id WHERE w.is_active = 1 ORDER BY w.title

upcoming_offerings.title: Upcoming Offerings
upcoming_offerings.sql: SELECT o.*, w.title as workshop FROM offerings o JOIN workshops w ON o.workshop_id = w.id WHERE o.start > datetime('now') ORDER BY o.start

workshops_by_instructor.title: Workshops by Instructor
workshops_by_instructor.sql: SELECT i.name, w.title, w.id FROM instructors i JOIN workshop_instructors wi ON i.id = wi.instructor_id JOIN workshops w ON wi.workshop_id = w.id WHERE w.is_active = 1 ORDER BY i.name, w.title

workshops_full.title: Workshops (Full Details)
workshops_full.sql: SELECT w.id, w.title, w.description, f.label as format, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.label) as areas, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT au.label) as audiences, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.name) as instructors FROM workshops w LEFT JOIN formats f ON w.format_id = f.id LEFT JOIN workshop_areas wa ON w.id = wa.workshop_id LEFT JOIN areas a ON wa.area_id = a.id LEFT JOIN workshop_audiences wau ON w.id = wau.workshop_id LEFT JOIN audiences au ON wau.audience_id = au.id LEFT JOIN workshop_instructors wi ON w.id = wi.workshop_id LEFT JOIN instructors i ON wi.instructor_id = i.id WHERE w.is_active = 1 GROUP BY w.id ORDER BY w.title
